fib: ______ is an agent having in the course of his business, as such agent, authority to sell or to consign goods for the purpose of sale, or to buy goods or to raise money on the security of goods.

A mercantile agent is an agent having in the course of his business, as such agent, authority to sell or to consign goods for the purpose of sale, or to buy goods or to raise money on the security of goods.
______ is defined as "a power, privilege or immunity guaranteed under a constitution, statute or decisional laws or claimed as a respect of long usage"(Black's Law Dictionary).
Right is defined as "a power, privilege or immunity guaranteed under a constitution, statute or decisional laws or claimed as a respect of long usage"(Black's Law Dictionary).
______ is the one to whom certain goods have been consigned for a foreign principal.
A commissioned agent is the one to whom certain goods have been consigned for a foreign principal.
______ is responsible irrespective of whether he knew, or ought to have known, or inadvertently thought that he had the authority he was supposed to have professed.
The agent alone is responsible irrespective of whether he knew, or ought to have known, or inadvertently thought that he had the authority he was supposed to have professed.
______ is an agent of necessity endowed by law with authority to pledge her husband's credit for necessaries.
A deserted wife is an agent of necessity endowed by law with authority to pledge her husband's credit for necessaries.

Consumerism is the combination of the outcome of consumer unrest, consumer awareness, consumer rights and consumer action.
